title: French Ratatouille
summary: A Provençal vegetable stew in which eggplant, zucchini, peppers, and tomatoes are gently simmered with olive oil and thyme.

steps.description: Cut the eggplant, zucchini, red pepper, and 3 tomatoes into roughly 2cm pieces. Finely chop the onion and mince 2 garlic cloves.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a wide pot over medium-high heat. Sauté the eggplant and zucchini for 5–6 minutes until the edges color, then transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil to the pot. Sauté the onion and red pepper for 4 minutes, then stir in the garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, 50ml water, and 1/2 tsp dried thyme. Bring to a simmer, then cook over medium-low heat with the lid slightly ajar for 10 minutes.
Return the eggplant and zucchini and simmer gently for another 15 minutes. Season with 3/4 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper and serve in 2 bowls.
